rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.future_notes against rust:mdbook-dada/src/units.rs:parse_block, rust:mdbook-dada/src/units.rs:parse, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:render_unit, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:ReviewBundle::prepare, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:record, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:check, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:future_notes_render_without_formalization_or_draft_status, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:future_notes_reject_formalizations_and_nested_specifications, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:future_notes_are_publishable_but_cannot_receive_correspondence_reviews. parse_block and parse reject formalization citations, draft status, nested units and non-top-level future notes while retaining ordinary dependencies/identity. render_unit emits a label without a source selector; prepare/record explicitly reject future notes and check reports not applicable. limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review.

Implementation/test inspection is correspondence evidence; actual command results are recorded separately. Tests do not prove universal behavior, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution.
